messages:
Jordan: Following the postmortem, I want to run a quick sweep to lock owners and realistic timelines for the KV-cache leak remediation items. Can folks confirm status and owners?

Maria: I can own the profiling deep-dive (heap traces + allocation waterfall). Targeting EOD Wednesday for an initial findings doc.

Devon: I will take GC tuning + fragment-trigger thresholds. Need to validate impact on latency in staging first. ETA next Tue.

Riley: I'll own rollout plan (canary configs + rollback guard). Also will add a temporary hard-limit flag to avoid noisy OOMs. Plan ready by Monday.

Samir: I'll do the patch to add defensiveness around ghost allocs in kv shard loader. Small change, putting up PR today.

Jordan: Nice. Maria, please include sampling commands and exact flags you used so we can reproduce.

Maria: Will do. Current sampling command: `perf record -g -F 99 -p <pid>` and we used `gcore` for full memory dumps. Adding steps + short script to repo.

Devon: For GC, I'm going to try incremental compaction parameter set: `--kv-compact-threshold=0.3 --fragmentation-watch=1` (draft). Will benchmark.

Riley: For the canary, proposing: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback if 95th latency increases > 12% or OOM rate > 0.5/hour. Anyone object?

Samir: Fine by me. Also will add extra metrics: ghost_alloc_count + kv_free_latency to observability.

OpsBot: Reminder: add owners to the postmortem board. Template: owner, task, ETA, risk, mitigations.

Jordan: Good call. I'll update the postmortem board with the three epics: profiling, runtime limits, rollout + observability.

Maria: Quick note — found memory spikes correlated with long-running cached prefixes > 64k. Will include a repro snippet.

Devon: If prefix length is the culprit, we should add a soft cap and LRU eviction tweak. I'll prototype after GC tests.

Riley: We should also communicate to impacted customers a temporary mitigation window (read-only degrade) if we detect repeated OOMs. I'll draft an internal playbook step.

Samir: PR posted: `fix/ghost-alloc-guard` — small guard + unit test. Linking in the postmortem.

Jordan: Action items recap (assignments + dates):
- Maria: profiling deep-dive doc + repro scripts (ETA Wed EOD)
- Devon: GC tuning benchmark + proposal (ETA Tue)
- Riley: canary + rollback configs + customer playbook draft (ETA Mon)
- Samir: merge ghost-alloc guard (PR posted) + add metrics (follow-up by Thu)
- Jordan: update postmortem board + send weekly follow-up email (ETA today)

Jordan: If nobody objects, I'll lock owners in the board and schedule a 30m sync Fri to review progress.

Maria: No objections. Sync Friday works.

Devon: Works for me.

Riley: Good. I'll prepare the canary runbook.

Samir: LGTM.

OpsBot: Calendar invite created: "KV leak remediation sync" Fri 10:00.

Jordan: Thanks all — appreciate the quick alignment. If anything slips, comment on the board and we'll triage.
